title: antiloki card body_json
description: Canonical shape for cards.body_json. See docs/card-schema.md for narrative. Enforced at write time by law-hook-card-body-schema.

kind.description: Role/intent of this card. Independent of size.

size.description: Scope tier. Hierarchy: L→M→S via parent_slug. L parents are NULL; M parents are L; S parents are M.

motivation.description: PRODUCT-SHAPE (canonical): what's wrong/missing/wanted and why it matters. The pain or goal, in product terms. The only non-list body field. Replaces 'problem'/'why'.

acceptance_criteria.description: PRODUCT-SHAPE: observable 'done' conditions in product terms (a user can X, Y stops happening). NOT test commands. Replaces 'outcome'/'acceptance'.

context.description: PRODUCT-SHAPE: background the AI/contract needs — how it works today, constraints, links, prior decisions. One item per point.

out_of_scope.description: PRODUCT-SHAPE: explicit out-of-bounds — 'not this card / don't touch X'. Replaces 'non_goals'.

reproduction.description: PRODUCT-SHAPE (kind=fix only): steps to reproduce + expected vs actual. One step/observation per item.

problem.description: LEGACY — superseded by 'motivation'. Kept allowed during the reshape transition; reshape converts problem→motivation.

why.description: LEGACY — superseded by 'motivation'. Kept allowed during the reshape transition; reshape converts why→motivation.

notes.description: Catch-all markdown for context not covered by structured fields.

diagnosis.description: Only meaningful when kind=fix. What went wrong.

trigger.description: Only meaningful when kind=prevent. What would re-cause this.

mitigation.description: Only meaningful when kind=prevent. How it's now blocked.

forbiddenKeys.description: These keys MUST NOT appear; they're either column duplicates or violate substrate structure. The lint action checks this list explicitly.
forbiddenKeys.note: 'motivation' was removed from this list — it is now the canonical PRODUCT-SHAPE field (was previously a why-alias).

renameRules.description: Mapping the normalizer uses to fix rule-fixable violations.
